comments.content: Congratulations, really interesting findings! Cutmix really does work well. Did you try experimenting with more augmentation for bigger cnn backbones? really counterintuitive to me why bigger model didn't perform better.

I tried using bigger models like convnext_base and maxvit_small, but their performance was worse. I haven't conducted detailed experiments, so I'm not certain, but I have two hypotheses. 😀

The first is that for bigger models to perform well, they require a sufficient dataset and a certain level of problem complexity. In this competition, those conditions weren't met, which likely led to overfitting and resulted in poorer performance compared to the smaller models.

The second is that I used an image size of (128, 128) instead of (224, 224), which may have been more detrimental to the bigger models.
Ahh I see, that makes much more sense.
